description: Read a Bible passage in one or more editions side by side (Hebrew WLC, Greek Septuagint, SBL Greek NT, English WEB/ASV/Douay-Rheims/Brenton, Russian Synodal, Luther 1912, Louis Segond). Verses are aligned to English numbering even where the Septuagint or Hebrew count differently.

editions.description: Edition ids from list_editions, e.g. ["hebrew","lxx","en"]. Default ["en"].

name: get_passage
